techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to exploit a weakness in an Internet-facing host or system to gain access.
techniques.mitigation: Patch vulnerable software, implement WAF, restrict exposed services

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining access.
techniques.mitigation: MFA enforcement, anomalous login alerting, privileged access management

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands and scripts.
techniques.mitigation: Script block logging, constrained language mode, application control

techniques.name: Phishing
techniques.description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems.
techniques.mitigation: Email filtering, user awareness training, link protection

techniques.name: External Remote Services
techniques.description: Adversaries may leverage external-facing remote services to initially access and persist within a victim network.
techniques.mitigation: MFA on remote services, geo-blocking, network segmentation

techniques.name: Network Service Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts.
techniques.mitigation: IDS/IPS rules, rate limiting, firewall egress filtering

techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts.
techniques.mitigation: Account lockout policies, CAPTCHA, rate limiting authentication attempts

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol
techniques.description: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols to avoid detection.
techniques.mitigation: Deep packet inspection, DNS monitoring, network traffic analysis

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
techniques.description: Adversaries may encrypt data on target systems to interrupt availability.
techniques.mitigation: Offline backups, EDR solutions, network segmentation to limit spread

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.description: Adversaries may steal data by exfiltrating it over an existing C2 channel.
techniques.mitigation: DLP solutions, egress filtering, anomalous bandwidth alerting

techniques.name: Impair Defenses
techniques.description: Adversaries may maliciously modify components of a victim environment to hinder security controls.
techniques.mitigation: Integrity monitoring, tamper protection on security tools

techniques.name: Process Injection
techniques.description: Adversaries may inject code into processes to evade process-based defenses.
techniques.mitigation: EDR behavioral monitoring, kernel-level protection, process isolation

techniques.name: Remote Services
techniques.description: Adversaries may use valid accounts to log into a service accepting remote connections.
techniques.mitigation: Network segmentation, disable unnecessary remote services, PAM

techniques.name: File and Directory Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may enumerate files and directories on a system.
techniques.mitigation: Audit file access events, least privilege file permissions

techniques.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or file difficult to discover or analyze.
techniques.mitigation: Static analysis tools, sandboxing, threat intelligence feeds

techniques.name: Account Manipulation
techniques.description: Adversaries may manipulate accounts to maintain or elevate access.
techniques.mitigation: Privileged account monitoring, directory change alerting

techniques.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
techniques.description: Adversaries may transfer tools from an external system into a compromised environment.
techniques.mitigation: Application whitelisting, egress filtering, proxy inspection

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to dump credentials to obtain account login information.
techniques.mitigation: Credential Guard, Protected Users group, EDR coverage

techniques.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
techniques.description: Adversaries may circumvent mechanisms designed to control privilege elevation.
techniques.mitigation: UAC enforcement, privilege monitoring, least privilege principle

techniques.name: Encrypted Channel
techniques.description: Adversaries may employ a known encryption algorithm to conceal C2 traffic.
techniques.mitigation: SSL inspection, certificate pinning monitoring, network anomaly detection

techniques.name: Remote System Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of other systems by IP address, hostname, or other logical identifier on a network.
techniques.mitigation: Network monitoring, disable unnecessary discovery protocols

techniques.name: Indicator Removal
techniques.description: Adversaries may delete or modify artifacts generated on a host system to remove evidence of their presence.
techniques.mitigation: Centralized logging, WORM storage for logs, integrity monitoring

techniques.name: Network Share Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may look for folders and drives shared on remote systems as a means of identifying potential targets.
techniques.mitigation: Disable unnecessary shares, monitor share access, network segmentation

techniques.name: System Network Connections Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of network connections to or from a compromised system.
techniques.mitigation: Limit discovery tool execution, behavioral monitoring

techniques.name: Scheduled Task/Job
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse task scheduling functionality to facilitate initial or recurring execution of malicious code.
techniques.mitigation: Scheduled task monitoring, least privilege, integrity checks

techniques.name: Create Account
techniques.description: Adversaries may create an account to maintain access to victim systems.
techniques.mitigation: Account creation alerting, regular account audits, PAM

techniques.name: Obtain Capabilities
techniques.description: Adversaries may buy and/or steal capabilities that can be used during targeting.
techniques.mitigation: Threat intelligence integration, file hash monitoring, sandbox analysis

techniques.name: Email Collection
techniques.description: Adversaries may target user email to collect sensitive information.
techniques.mitigation: Email access monitoring, DLP on email systems, MFA

techniques.name: System Information Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get detailed information about a system's OS and hardware.
techniques.mitigation: Behavioral analytics, limit WMI usage, honeypot deployment

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
techniques.description: Adversaries may configure system settings to execute programs during system boot or logon.
techniques.mitigation: Integrity monitoring on autostart locations, Secure Boot, boot logging
